curtain.fetching: fetching the books and dictionary, just this once
curtain.taking_longer: this is taking longer than usual…
curtain.books_downloading: the books are still downloading. you can start now, and they'll finish in the background.
curtain.still_loading: still loading. check your connection, then reload. once kalibre has loaded here, it works offline.
curtain.older_tab: kalibre is open in another tab, on an older version. close that tab and this one will carry on.
curtain.couldnt_load: kalibre couldn't load. check your connection, then reload.
curtain.browser_too_old: this browser is too old for kalibre. a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari will run it.

meta.description: Your typing. Your mistakes. Your progress. A typing trainer that learns your recurring mistakes and drills them, right in your browser.
meta.alt_wordmark: The kalibre wordmark between Cal and Libby, with the line: your typing, your mistakes, your progress.

pwa.ios: On iPhone and iPad, add kalibre to your home screen (in Safari: share → add to home screen). It opens full screen and keeps its data, where a Safari tab can lose it after 7 days without a visit.
pwa.generic: Add kalibre to your home screen (the browser's menu → add to home screen, or install). Installed, it opens full screen, and the browser is readier to keep its data.

backup.nothing: there’s nothing to back up yet

backup.downloaded: downloaded {count, plural, one {# profile file} other {# profile files}}
